title.en: Types of networks: PAN, LAN, MAN, WAN
title.kn: ಜಾಲಗಳ ವಿಧಗಳು: PAN, LAN, MAN, WAN

heading.en: From your pocket to the planet

hook.en: Your earbuds talk to your phone, your lab computers talk to each other, your city's cable network spans many kilometres, and the Internet spans the globe. Networks come in sizes.
hook.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಇಯರ್‌ಬಡ್‌ಗಳು ಫೋನಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ, ಲ್ಯಾಬ್ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗಳು ಪರಸ್ಪರ, ನಗರದ ಕೇಬಲ್ ಜಾಲ ಹಲವು ಕಿಲೋಮೀಟರ್, ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲ ಇಡೀ ಭೂಮಿ. ಜಾಲಗಳಿಗೆ ಗಾತ್ರಗಳಿವೆ.

objectives.en: Classify networks by the area they cover
Give examples of PAN, LAN, MAN and WAN

narration.en: Your earbuds talk to your phone, your lab computers talk to each other, your city's cable network spans many kilometres, and the Internet spans the globe. Networks come in sizes.
narration.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಇಯರ್‌ಬಡ್‌ಗಳು ಫೋನಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ, ಲ್ಯಾಬ್ ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ಗಳು ಪರಸ್ಪರ, ನಗರದ ಕೇಬಲ್ ಜಾಲ ಹಲವು ಕಿಲೋಮೀಟರ್, ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲ ಇಡೀ ಭೂಮಿ. ಜಾಲಗಳಿಗೆ ಗಾತ್ರಗಳಿವೆ.

body.en: A Personal Area Network (PAN) connects one person's devices within about 10 m, using Bluetooth or USB. A Local Area Network (LAN) connects computers in a room, building or campus, up to about 1 km, using Ethernet cables, Wi-Fi, switches. A Metropolitan Area Network (MAN) covers a city, roughly 30–40 km, such as a cable TV or city broadband network. A Wide Area Network (WAN) connects LANs and MANs across cities, countries and continents; the Internet is the largest WAN.

narration.en: Networks grow from PAN, about 10 metres, to LAN, about a kilometre, to MAN, a city, to WAN, which spans countries. The Internet is the biggest WAN.
narration.kn: ಜಾಲಗಳು PAN (ಸುಮಾರು 10 ಮೀ), LAN (ಸುಮಾರು 1 ಕಿಮೀ), MAN (ಒಂದು ನಗರ), WAN (ದೇಶಗಳಾದ್ಯಂತ) ಎಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ WAN.

title.en: On the board: Network sizes from PAN to WAN

say.en: A personal area network connects one person’s devices, within about 10 metres, using Bluetooth or USB.
A local area network covers a room, a building or a campus, up to about a kilometre.
A metropolitan area network covers a city, about 30 to 40 kilometres.
A wide area network connects networks across countries and continents. The Internet is the largest WAN.

narration.en: We draw networks as growing circles, from one person’s devices to the whole world.

prompt.en: Sort each network by the area it covers.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಜಾಲವನ್ನು ಅದು ಆವರಿಸುವ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಂತೆ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

text.en: Bluetooth earbuds connected to a phone
A smartwatch syncing with its owner's phone
The computer lab network of a college
Wi-Fi connecting the devices in a home
A cable TV network across Bengaluru
A bank network linking its branches all over India

explanation.en: A PAN serves one person's devices, a LAN a room, building or campus, a MAN a city, and a WAN links LANs and MANs across countries; the Internet is the largest WAN.
explanation.kn: PAN ಒಬ್ಬರ ಸಾಧನಗಳು, LAN ಕಟ್ಟಡ/ಕ್ಯಾಂಪಸ್, MAN ನಗರ, WAN ದೇಶಗಳಾದ್ಯಂತ; ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ WAN.

problem.en: Classify: (i) a smartwatch synced to a phone, (ii) an office's 40 computers on one floor, (iii) a city-wide traffic-camera network, (iv) an airline booking system used worldwide.

steps.en: (i) One person's devices, a few metres apart → PAN.

homework.en: Give one example of each type of network that you use every week.

narration.en: Recap. PAN: personal devices, about 10 m. LAN: a building or campus, about 1 km. MAN: a city. WAN: countries and continents; the Internet is the largest WAN.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. PAN: ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಸಾಧನಗಳು, ಸುಮಾರು 10 ಮೀ. LAN: ಕಟ್ಟಡ ಅಥವಾ ಆವರಣ, ಸುಮಾರು 1 ಕಿಮೀ. MAN: ಒಂದು ನಗರ. WAN: ದೇಶ, ಖಂಡಗಳಾದ್ಯಂತ; ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ WAN.
